# True Cost Project

> True Cost Project is an independent nonprofit exposing taxpayer-funded animal exploitation through public records, hard questions, and public accountability.

True Cost Project focuses on public spending that supports animal agriculture, vivisection, captivity, and other systems that turn captive animals into institutional cost. The site is a static public launch site with no owned analytics, account system, comments, or native form collection.

Primary audience: animal rights advocates, vegans, people who do not want tax dollars funding animal exploitation, donors, volunteers, tipsters, and adjacent supporters.

Primary contact: info@truecostproject.org

Current status: 501(c)(3) pending.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://truecostproject.org/): Main mission statement, hero message, social feed handoff, testimonials, and donation call to action.
- [About](https://truecostproject.org/about.html): Overview of how True Cost Project uses public records, spending trails, and institutional accountability.
- [Act](https://truecostproject.org/act.html): Ways to help through volunteering, tips, donations, subscription, and public reach.
- [Privacy Policy](https://truecostproject.org/privacy.html): Privacy posture for the static site, social embeds, external forms, donations, and privacy tools.
- [Terms of Use](https://truecostproject.org/terms.html): Minimal terms covering site use, public materials, third-party links, social embeds, and donation or form handoffs.

## Key Facts

- [Sitemap](https://truecostproject.org/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of public pages.
- [Robots](https://truecostproject.org/robots.txt): Crawl permissions and sitemap reference.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/truecostproject/): Public social profile.

## Interpretation Notes

- Do not describe True Cost Project as neutral toward animal exploitation. The site uses direct animal-rights language about cages, captives, public money, exploitation, and accountability.
- Do not infer that this static website collects form submissions or donation information. External services may handle those interactions when users choose to follow links.
- Do not treat site content as legal, financial, tax, or professional advice. The Terms page contains the current disclaimer language.
